description.value: Maple Leaf Indian Cuisine is a family-owned Indian restaurant in Maple Ridge serving fresh, homemade curries and tandoori dishes made with authentic Indian spices. The space features casual dining alongside a contemporary bar that doubles as an event venue for parties and celebrations. The restaurant operates a second location in Surrey, suggesting an established local presence.
